// Classifier fixture, node:test: CONDITIONAL-ONLY, the CONDITIONAL and GUARDED-RETURN flags, and
// their negative. Read as text by tests/classify.test.ts.
import { test } from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";

test("parses the year", () => {
  const result = parse("2024");
  result.ok && assert.equal(result.value.year, 2024);
});

test("creates the asset", (t) => {
  const result = MediaAsset.create(input);
  if (!result.ok) {
    return;
  }
  t.assert.equal(result.value.kind, "image");
});

test("creates the asset after asserting success", () => {
  const result = MediaAsset.create(input);
  assert.ok(result.ok);
  if (!result.ok) return;
  assert.equal(result.value.kind, "image");
});
